FACT-1.gloss: The duration from 1:00 PM to 5:00 PM is 4 hours

FACT-2.gloss: The candle melts at a rate of 2 centimeters per hour

RULE-1.gloss: For any times x and y, any duration n, any melting rate r, and any product p, if the duration from x to y is n hours, the candle melts at r centimeters per hour, and r multiplied by n equals p, then the candle is p centimeters shorter
RULE-1.formula: ∀x∀y∀n∀r∀p (Duration(x, y, n) ∧ MeltRate(r) ∧ Product(r, n, p) → Shorter(p))

INF-1.gloss: The candle is 8 centimeters shorter after burning from 1:00 PM to 5:00 PM, from FACT-1, FACT-2, FACT-3, and RULE-1 by Universal Instantiation and Modus Ponens
